name: dba-kit
description: PeoplesHR database tooling for DBAs. Ships the phx-sql-standards-review skill for reviewing T-SQL against the OLD hSenid HRM or NEW PeoplesHR PHR-X SQL standards, and the phx-dbexplorer MCP server for browsing a SQL Server or Postgres schema. Both moved here from org-standards in its 4.0.0 release.
